new_destinations.name: Mornington Peninsula
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage region page "Mornington Peninsula" (listed as a counted source for Peninsula Hot Springs and Arthurs Seat State Park); Visit Mornington Peninsula tourism brand (visitmorningtonpeninsula.org); Mornington Peninsula National Park (Parks Victoria).
new_destinations.reason: 27 kept spots from Point Nepean to Coolart; named region (not a town). Mornington Peninsula National Park and Point Nepean National Park would be destinations on their own but sit inside the peninsula (centres within 0.75 of its radius), so they are spots of it. Centre set west of the middle so it clears Phillip Island by the overlap test.

standalone_near_destination_notes.French Island: About 20 km from Phillip Island centre and ~33 km from Mornington Peninsula centre, but reached by its own passenger ferry from Stony Point (or Cowes) and visited as its own overnight/bike trip, not from either base; the Wikivoyage page is separate. Standalone, not a spot of Phillip Island.
standalone_near_destination_notes.State Coal Mine: ~33 km from Phillip Island centre, across Western Port on the Bass Coast mainland; reached via Wonthaggi, outside the island destination span (75% of 40 km = 30 km). Standalone.
standalone_near_destination_notes.Bunurong Marine National Park: More than 40 km from Phillip Island centre and in the Bass Coast/Gippsland side; 3 kept places on this coast (park, Inverloch, State Coal Mine) is below the four-spot bar for a destination, so standalone; Gippsland region pass may already own a nearer base.
standalone_near_destination_notes.Inverloch: Same Bass Coast cluster as Bunurong and State Coal Mine (3 spots, no destination); ~45 km from Phillip Island, outside its span. Standalone.
